import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])

    if w <= 3:
        print("YES")
        return

    limit = 100000000000
    a = [0] * 40
    a[0] = 1
    temp = 1
    n = 1

    while n < 16:
        temp *= w
        a[n] = temp
        if temp > limit:
            break
        n += 1

    balances = {0}
    for i in range(n):
        next_balances = set()
        for v in balances:
            next_balances.add(v)
            next_balances.add(v + a[i])
            next_balances.add(v - a[i])
        balances = next_balances

    print("YES" if m in balances else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
